item.title: Scaling Data Pipelines @ Magenta Telekom
item.description: Magenta Telekom ingests many terabytes of new data every day, and every downstream consumer wants it immediately. The real bottleneck turned out not to be hardware but humans wrestling with hidden, hard-wired dependencies in hundreds of heterogeneous pipelines and sometimes tool silos. Our fix was to treat every data asset as a node in a data-dependency graph and every transformation as an edge. Ingestion, Transformation, AI and BI are all part of the same executable graph.
